fee_items.fee_name: Building Combination Permit + Building Plan Check (800 sq ft)
fee_items.internal_notes: Valuation = 800 sq ft x $175.92 = $140,736 (IB-077 R-3 Type VB). Building permit = $1,080 + 40.736 x $4.98 = $1,282.87. Combination R-3 permit = 150% = $1,924.30. Building plan check = 75% of building permit = $962.15. Total = $1,924.30 + $962.15 = $2,886.45.
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026 adopted fee adjustments; IB-077 valuation

fee_items.fee_name: Development Impact Fees - Fire, Parks & Police (ADU rates)
fee_items.internal_notes: Per-dwelling-unit ADU rates: Fire Facilities $241.74 + Parks & Recreation $1,781.39 + Police Facilities $342.86 = $2,365.99. Transportation Improvement Fee excluded: the official table has no ADU row for Transportation, and the tier for an ADU over 640 sq ft is unclear ($663.75 secondary tier vs $1,125 full rate).
fee_items.source_note: City DIF fee schedule (ADU rates, eff. 10/01/18)

fee_items.internal_notes: LBUSD residential developer fee $5.38/sq ft. Assessed on ADUs over 500 sq ft (Gov. Code 65995.1(f)). 800 sq ft = $4,304.

fee_items.fee_name: Sewer Capacity Charge (actual ADU permit charge)
fee_items.internal_notes: Actual Sewer Capacity - Residential charge from the official ADU permit sample ($208.98). Sewer is charged per fixture/EFU x Board rate (Resolution WD-1441A), no ADU-specific published formula, so the 800 sq ft new-construction amount cannot be reverse-engineered from public documents (~$209+ expected).
fee_items.source_note: Official ADU permit sample (579 sq ft garage conversion, 2025-06-11)

fee_items.internal_notes: Accessory Dwelling Unit Review (Planning) $475/review. Up from $361 in FY 2025-26.

GUSD residential developer fee $5.38/sq ft. ADUs 500 sq ft and over assessed, under 500 exempt (Gov. Code 65995.1(f), SB 543). 800 sq ft = $4,304.

fee_items.fee_name: Building Permit + Plan Check (R-3 Type B, 800 sq ft)
fee_items.internal_notes: R-3 Type B (wood frame) tiers, 800 sq ft = base 0-999 SF + 3 x per-100-SF over 500 SF. Permit: $1,647.14 + 3 x $165.02 = $2,142.20. Plan check: $1,193.28 + 3 x $118.77 = $1,549.59. Total = $3,691.79.
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026-27 adopted citywide fee schedule (Resolution 26-29,706, adopted 2026-06-02)

fee_items.internal_notes: Fee schedule line item 'Accessory Dwelling Unit' $1,728.42/application. BMC 10-1-620.7 references the ADU permit application fee. Whether it applies to ministerial (by-right) ADU permits is unconfirmed - it sits under the Pre-Development Review category.
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026-27 fee schedule, Planning Pre-Development Review (C)(6)

fee_items.fee_name: Public Works ADU Plan Check Review
fee_items.internal_notes: Fee schedule line item 'Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Plan Check Reviews' $273.95.

fee_items.fee_name: Development Impact Fees (Transportation + Community Facilities, pro-rata)
fee_items.internal_notes: Single-family market-rate: Transportation $9,647.29 + Community Facilities $5,519.04 = $15,166.33/unit, plus 5% development administration surcharge. ADUs 750 sq ft and over charged pro-rata to primary dwelling: ratio = 800 / 1,800 sq ft = 44.44% (1,800 sq ft reference primary dwelling per brief example), so $15,166.33 x 44.44% = $6,740.59 + 5% = $7,077.62. Under 750 sq ft exempt. Actual amount varies with primary dwelling size (LA County Assessor record).
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026-27 fee schedule ARTICLE VIII Sec. 3 + BMC 10-1-620.3(K)(2) + ADU DIF calculation guide (2026-01-01)

fee_items.internal_notes: Justification study authorizes Level I max $5.38/sq ft; ADUs over 500 sq ft levied (SB 543). Resolution No. 1-27 (adopting $5.38) was on the 2026-08-06 board agenda but passage is unconfirmed - if not adopted, the prior $5.17 rate (adopted 2025-04-03) applies. 800 sq ft = $4,304 at $5.38.

Single-family residential $2,043/residence, ADUs over 750 sq ft charged pro-rata to the 1,800 sq ft average household basis: $2,043 x 800/1,800 = $908.00. ADUs 750 sq ft and under pay $0. Sewer tap application fee $90.20 excluded (administrative).
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026-27 fee schedule, Exhibit A footnote (e) (BMC 25-801-803)

fee_items.internal_notes: Worked total for 800 sq ft ADU computed from official tier table: tier $100,001-$250,000 = $1,471.39 + 61.12 x $10.65. Assumes valuation $161,120 (800 SF x $201.40 R-3 Type VB). R-3 rate unconfirmed (FY 2026/27 valuation table PDF extraction broken; $201.40 is ICC BVD Aug 2024 match, unverified). FY 2026/27 fee schedule adoption unconfirmed.

fee_items.internal_notes: Official formula: Plan Review = 70% of building permit fee. Worked total assumes permit $2,122. Handicap/Energy/Green/NPDES add-ons excluded (ADU applicability unconfirmed per brief).
Official formula: 0.13% of construction valuation. Worked total assumes valuation $161,120 (R-3 rate unverified, see building permit note).

fee_items.fee_name: ADU development impact fee (flat per ADU)
fee_items.internal_notes: Series-first flat ADU DIF: $2,243.47 per ADU, not proportional to primary dwelling (SF $10,557.90 / MF $8,973.98 per unit for comparison). Schedule text: 'ADU 750 SF or greater in size.' ADUs under 750 sq ft pay $0. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) will require marginal pro-rata on area over 750 sq ft, so this flat structure must be revised.
fee_items.source_note: Planning Fee Schedule, Development Impact Fees, FY 2024/25 & Beyond (eff. 2024-07-01)

fee_items.internal_notes: Level 1 residential rate $5.38/sq ft (= 2026 state statutory max). Resolution does not mention ADU explicitly; ADU qualifies as residential construction under state law. City Building & Safety page still shows old $5.17 (stale). No Level 2 history. 800 sq ft = $4,304.

fee_items.fee_name: Combined plan check + building permit (Tier 3, Residential Category 2)
fee_items.internal_notes: Series-only combined fee (plan check included, no separate %). Worked total for 800 sq ft assumes Residential Category 2 (Dwellings): $1,225 + 3 x $148.93 = $1,671.79. ADU category classification is Building Division's call.
fee_items.source_note: Combined Plan Check and Building Permit Fees, Tier 3: Type IIB/IIIB/IV/VB

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (AUHSD + Anaheim Elementary SD)
fee_items.internal_notes: Two-district 50/50 split: AUHSD (grades 7-12) $2.69/sq ft per resolution, Anaheim Elementary SD $2.69/sq ft (AUHSD collects on feeder districts' behalf). Resolution text explicitly states 'inclusive of Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)' - series first. No Level 2 history. 800 sq ft = $4,304. Applies to typical residential areas; 6 districts exist citywide.

Adopted-rate total $19,521/unit = Police $1,128 + Fire & Rescue $759 + Library $1,610 + Parks $16,022. ADUs >=750 sq ft pay proportionately (ADU sq ft / primary dwelling sq ft) per Gov. Code 66324/66311.5 rule; ADUs <750 sq ft exempt. City reply 2026-10-07 confirmed park fees apply at 750 sq ft and above. Caveats: 2026-03-24 resolution final adoption date unconfirmed; DTA study's worked example uses max-justified base ($49,522.77, = $15,847.29 for 800/2,500) while adopted base is $19,521 (= $6,247 for 800/2,500 or $10,411 for 800/1,500). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) requires marginal pro-rata revision.
fee_items.source_note: 2026 DIF Fee Schedule (Proposed); DTA DIF Justification Study 2026-02-12

fee_items.internal_notes: UPDATED per city reply: sanitation fees average $1.71/sq ft. 800 sq ft ADU = $1,368 on straight average; $1,710 if Table A's 'per 1,000 sq ft or portion thereof' rounds up. Post uses range $1,368-$1,710. Imposition timing vs. city ordinance burden-proportionate connection charge unconfirmed.

NPDES 5%, General Plan Update Fee $2/$1,000 valuation, issuance $63, system upgrade $15 are separate add-ons not included here.

fee_items.internal_notes: Two-district split per Ed. Code 17623(a) allocation: FJUHSD (grades 9-12) 33.33% = $1.79/sq ft (justified in official 2026 study) + Fullerton SD (K-8) 66.67% = $3.59/sq ft (arithmetic from $5.38 max; FSD's own 2026 adoption unconfirmed). Combined $5.38 = 2026 statutory max, justified. No Level 2 history. 800 sq ft = $4,304.
fee_items.source_note: FJUHSD 2026 Fee Justification Study (2026-04-21); statutory max $5.38

fee_items.internal_notes: Worked example for 800 sq ft ADU: Park Dwelling Fee $12,020/unit x (800 / 1,500 sq ft primary dwelling) = $6,411. REFERENCE HOUSE SIZE: 1,500 sq ft primary dwelling (brief's assumption). ADU >=750 sq ft pays proportionately to primary dwelling; <750 exempt per Ord. 3343. City's actual pro-rata interpretation (denominator basis) unconfirmed. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) requires marginal pro-rata revision.

Table A: ADUs charged at average demand rate = $1,710 per 1,000 sq ft or portion thereof; 800 sq ft ADU = $1,710. Fullerton is an OC San board-member city. Whether CFCC is imposed on an ADU (ordinance treats ADU as not a new residential use but allows burden-proportionate charges) is unconfirmed - rate recorded only.

fee_items.fee_name: Garden Grove Unified SD developer fee (residential, Level 1)
fee_items.internal_notes: GGUSD is a K-12 unified district with a single residential rate. 2026 state Level 1 max is $5.38/sq ft but GGUSD adoption of $5.38 was not confirmed as of 2026-10-06 (would be $4,304 at 800 sq ft). SB 543: only ADUs at or under 500 sq ft interior livable space are exempt; an 800 sq ft ADU is charged on the full area (cliff, not marginal). $5.17 x 800 sq ft = $4,136.

fee_items.fee_name: Combined school developer fee, Level 1 basis (SM-Bonita + SMJUHSD)
fee_items.internal_notes: Conservative verified basis per brief: 2026 state Level 1 statutory max $5.38/sq ft applied through the district split (elementary 71.43%, high school 28.57%); $5.38 x 800 sq ft = $4,304. Both districts justified Level 2 fees by study (elementary $7.02 + high school $2.96 = $9.98/sq ft, i.e. $7,984 at 800 sq ft) but 2026 adoption resolutions were not confirmed as of 2026-10-06, so Level 2 is conditional only and excluded here.
fee_items.source_note: 2026 State Allocation Board Level 1 statutory max; Level I Split Agreement (elementary 71.43% / high school 28.57%)

fee_items.fee_name: Sacramento City Unified school developer fee (residential)
fee_items.internal_notes: SCUSD covers most of the city; other in-city districts have their own rates (e.g. Elk Grove USD $7.32, Twin Rivers USD $5.17, Natomas USD $5.17, San Juan USD $3.79). The city worksheet lists no 750 sq ft waiver for the school fee, so it is treated as charged on the ADU. $5.13 x 800 sq ft = $4,104.
